#	query = root.getAlarmTags(u)

	results = system.tag.browse(path, {"tagType":"AtomicTag"} )
	ds = []
	# Regex explanation:
	# (/[^/]+/[^/_]+)  -> Captures / followed by characters, another /, and then the ID (FBKR01)
	# (_SP|_VARSP|_VCMD|_CMD|_VSIG|_MODE|SEC_DP_MODE)$ -> Matches only if it ends in your list
	pattern = re.compile(r'.*(_FB|_VFB)$')   # adjust suffix as needed
	for r in results:
		rp = str(r["fullPath"])
		j = {}
		if re.search(pattern,rp) != None:
			if "alarm" in r['attributes']:
				config = system.tag.getConfiguration(rp)
				for c in config:
					ids = []
					alarms = c['alarms']
					alms = {}
					alms['tagpath'] = rp 
					for a in alarms:
						j ={}
						
						j['label'] = a['name']
						if 'setpointA' not in a:
							j['value'] = 0
						else:
							j['value'] = a['setpointA']
						ids.append(j)	
					alms['alarms'] = ids
					ds.append(alms)
	return ds

	# (_SP|_VARSP|_VCMD|_CMD|_VSIG|_MODE|SEC_DP_MODE)$ -> Matches only if it ends in your list
	pattern = r"(/[^/]+/[^/_]+)(_SP|_VARSP|_VCMD|_CMD|_VSIG|_MODE|SEC_DP_MODE)$"
	for r in results:
		rp = str(r["fullPath"])
		match = re.search(pattern,rp)
		if match:
			j = {}
			j["tagpath"] = rp
			ds.append(j)
	return ds
